content: My perception is that the lambda calculi are going to be implemented in nameless, locally nameless, and named versions, respectively for the categorical purists, proof engineering ergonomists, and the nominal set sadists (I apologise for the coarseness of this joke!). Is this roughly correct, and does the former have an agreed format? For example, intrinsically typed, intrinsically scoped, etc. (Unfortunately intrinsically typed dependent types will not be possible without the non-existent induction-induction)

On this note, would contributions be welcome in constructivising the lambda calculi development?
The grind tactic uses choice almost always.
Actually, this is infeasible for the locally nameless representation
